findings.details: Documentation upgrade command does not pass --key-dir. When its default directory lacks the previous private key, initIssuer intentionally creates a new issuer. Require the existing key path for an upgrade or describe initial installation separately.
findings.resolution: Applied in docs/WYDANIE-ALPHA.md: existing key required and canonicalized before cd, --key-dir explicit, /tmp checkout0755 and release-desktop0755/deb0644.

findings.details: Observed built .deb mode0600. chmod755 checkout alone does not make the package readable for _apt; set package0644 and ensure traversable ancestors. A private TMPDIR ancestor may remain0711/0700 despite checkout0755.
findings.resolution: Applied in docs/WYDANIE-ALPHA.md: existing key required and canonicalized before cd, --key-dir explicit, /tmp checkout0755 and release-desktop0755/deb0644.

findings.topic: Commit identifier with arbitrary local edits
findings.details: Vite reads git rev-parse HEAD, not git dirty state. Ignored generated public key keeps tracked source clean. release:linux requires a clean tree; install-local itself allows dirty source, so its SHA alone is not proof of identical files.
Build-only and Debian postinst do not write user profile. Starting the application may update its existing data; migration and rollback still need target-system acceptance.
